'''2000 Death Star II Pre-Release (Houston)''' was a Star Wars CCG pre-release on 24 June 2000. [[Chris Gregg]] won it. It is known from Brian Guthrie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d943">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-red-81-s-dantooine-regional-report-6-25d943/ red-81-s-dantooine-regional-report-6-25], DeckTech (Brian "Red 81" Guthrie, 26 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-red-81-s-dantooine-regional-report-6-25d943/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2000 Dantooine Regionals]].

* '''Date:''' 24 June 2000
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Gregg]]
